message: So, there I was, feeling pretty proud of myself for reminding everyone to check the smoke alarms before our big family dinner. Fast forward to the meal prep chaos, and guess what? One of my alarms went off just as I was pulling a batch of cookies out of the oven. I couldn't help but chuckle at the timing—smugly thinking, ‘I told you so!’ It’s those little reminders that keep our homes safe and our cookies perfectly crisp. Who's due for a smoke alarm check? 🍪
